citation: Breakout Index (breakout-0.2). (2026-11-16). 破圈資料集 v0.3 [Data set].

reach.descZh: 有多少人接觸到這部作品：播放／觀看、加入清單、評分人數的規模（取對數後換算 0–100）。
reach.descEn: How many people the work reached: plays, watchlist adds and rating counts, log-scaled to 0–100.

quality.descZh: 貝氏收縮後的評分（向母體均值收縮，避免小樣本高分奪冠）。
quality.descEn: Bayesian-shrunk rating: small-sample scores are pulled toward the cohort mean.

buzz.descZh: 社群參與度：評分人數、短評與彈幕、二創與搜尋的增量斜率。
buzz.descEn: Community participation: rating volume, reviews, danmaku, fanwork and search slope.

momentum.descZh: 近期熱度變化速度；爆款看斜率，不看總量。
momentum.descEn: Recent rate of change. Breakouts are judged by slope, not totals.

crossover.descZh: 討論與核心粉絲參與「超出觀看規模」的幅度（已對 reach 正交化）：能否吸引核心圈層以外的注意力。
crossover.descEn: Discussion and core-fan engagement in excess of audience size, orthogonalised against reach: can it attract attention beyond its core audience?
